summary: Sign check on the C-form: n = 4Cuv − u − v gives 1/(Cuv) + 1/(nCv) + 1/(nCu) = (n+u+v)/(nCuv) = 4/n, so positivity of all three denominators follows from u, v, C, n ≥ 1; no sign rewriting is needed.
